longBio:
I am a digital developer focused on building thoughtful, user-centered web experiences and reliable online systems.

My work spans design-minded front-end development, practical problem solving, and collaborative implementation across a range of projects and teams.

I enjoy helping businesses and organizations build clean, effective digital products that are easy to maintain and easy to trust.

videoOptions.transcript:
I enjoy building digital experiences that are both effective and easy to use.

My work often sits at the intersection of front-end development, systems thinking, and practical problem solving.

I'm especially interested in thoughtful solutions, clear communication, and creating tools that help people work with confidence.

I value a collaborative process and look for opportunities to build work that is useful, scalable, and easy to maintain.
